exam_scheme.note: Recruitment for Police Constable is conducted by Karnataka State Police Recruitment Board in three stages: Stage 1 Written Examination (100 marks, 90 minutes OMR based), Stage 2 Endurance Test (ET) & Physical Standard Test (PST) (shortlisted at 1:5 ratio), followed by Stage 3 Document Verification and Medical Examination. Negative marking in the written test is 0.25 marks per incorrect answer.

stages.source_label: KSP Constable Written Examination Syllabus and Blueprint

papers.paper_name: General Studies, Constitution of India, History, Geography, Science, Current Affairs & Mental Ability (Bilingual: Kannada & English)
papers.negative_marking: 0.25 marks deducted per incorrect answer (25% penalty)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Merit determines 1:5 shortlisting for Endurance and Physical tests

stages.source_label: KSP ET & PST Directives for Civil Police Constable

papers.paper_name: Male Candidates: 1,600m Run (max 6m 30s), Long Jump (min 3.80m) or High Jump (min 1.20m), Shot Put 7.26 kg (min 5.60m) & Height/Chest measurement
papers.qualifying_threshold: Qualifying standards (Height: min 168 cm, Chest: 86 cm with 5 cm expansion)

papers.paper_name: Female & Transgender Candidates: 1,000m Run (max 6 mins), Long Jump (min 2.75m) or High Jump (min 0.90m), Shot Put 4 kg (min 3.75m) & Height measurement

stages.source_label: KSP Medical Board Standards & Document Verification Directives

papers.paper_name: Verification of PUC / 10+2 Certificate, Kannada Medium Certificate, Rural Certificate, Caste / HK Certificate & Medical Examination
papers.qualifying_threshold: Document verification and medical fitness qualifying

financial_package.note: Constables in Karnataka State Police are appointed in the 7th State Pay Commission scale of ₹23,500–₹47,650 with entry basic pay of ₹23,500.
financial_package.pay_source_label: Karnataka State Police Revised Pay Rules Schedule
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on entry basic pay of ₹23,500 at 58% DA (₹13,630 effective 01.07.2025), HRA (9% to 27%: ₹2,115 to ₹6,345 across district and Bengaluru city limits), Uniform Allowance, Washing Allowance, Risk Allowance, net of NPS deduction (10% of Basic+DA = ₹3,713) and Professional Tax.
official_perks: Dearness Allowance (DA) revised semi-annually per Karnataka Finance Department orders
House Rent Allowance (HRA) categorized by posting zone (Bengaluru metro vs district stations)
Police uniform maintenance allowance, kit replacement grant, and stitching subsidy
Special risk allowance for law & order and armed police personnel
Cashless medical treatment for police personnel and family under Jyothi Sanjeevini Scheme
Pension coverage under National Pension System (NPS)
